title: Must see in Barcelona!!
text: Amazing experience. Marco was tour guide and he was great. Make it a point to see Sagrada de Familia!!
author: Ann_K

title: Great visit with a fantastic guide
text:
Deliberately booked a tour with a smaller party to get a better experience and wasn’t disappointed. Overall experience of the tour was that it was well managed, with clear meeting instructions and getting into the Sagrada Família was as smooth as can be, for such a popular destination. 

What made the tour stand out was our guide, Montse. She was able to navigate the group into spaces among the crowds to be able to talk to us and allow us a great view of what was being highlighted. She was incredibly knowledgable of the venue, being able to answer all the questions put to her.  She didn’t try

title: Informative and Fun
text: This was a wonderful tour!  We learned so much more than we would have without the input of our tour guide, Monsarte.    She was thoughtful and kind, as well as knowledgeable.   It was a great experience and manageable despite jet lag exhaustion
